title: Message
description: Canonical event published by every Ratatoskr bridge to NATS subject ratatoskr.messages.

id.description: Idempotency key. Consumers must treat this as the deduplication key.

parent_session_id.description: Set only for subagent sessions. Omitted (not null) when absent.

git_branch.description: Always present on the wire. Detached HEAD is encoded as the sentinel '(detached)'.

project.description: Derived from cwd at bridge time. May be empty for sessions outside a git repo.

timestamp.description: Message production time. Used for ordering within a session — no sequence field exists.
